meta.name: amazon-best-selling-products-finder-api-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users extract structured best-selling product data from Amazon via the BrowserAct API. Agent should proactively apply this skill when users express needs like search for best selling products on Amazon, extract Amazon product data based on keywords, find top rated Amazon products, monitor Amazon competitor prices and sales, discover trending products on Amazon marketplace, extract Amazon product titles prices and ratings, gather Amazon product sales volume for market research, search Amazon best sellers in specific region, collect Amazon product reviews and promotion details, analyze Amazon product availability and badges, get Amazon product data for market analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取亚马逊畅销商品的结构化数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在亚马逊上搜索并提取畅销商品数据。
copy.tagline_en: Extract structured best-selling product data from Amazon
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search and extract best-selling product data from Amazon.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据关键词从亚马逊提取结构化商品数据，包括标题、价格、评分、销量、促销信息等。
howto.when: 当用户提出搜索亚马逊热销商品、提取商品数据、监控价格或销量等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下亚马逊上‘gaming mouse’的热销商品。
say.note: 返回商品列表，含价格、评分等。

say.text: 提取亚马逊美国站‘running shoes’的前20个商品数据。
对比亚马逊英国站和德国站上‘iphone 17’的价格。
say.note: 需分别调用两次或指定不同市场。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extract structured product data from Amazon based on keywords, including titles, prices, ratings, reviews, sales volume, and promotions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users request to search for best-selling products, extract product data, monitor prices or sales on Amazon.

say_en.text: Search for best-selling 'gaming mouse' on Amazon.
say_en.note: Returns product list with prices, ratings, etc.

say_en.text: Extract top 20 'running shoes' products from Amazon US.
Compare prices of 'iphone 17' on Amazon UK and Germany.
say_en.note: May require two calls or specify different marketplaces.
